shortlist.selection_rationale: Options price a ~19% move on a Shopee-guidance/margin question with dense, well-tracked KPI history across Shopee/Garena/SeaMoney to synthesize.
Large-cap space name with huge implied move and rich launch-cadence/Neutron-timeline data points to synthesize, though sentiment/multiple risk is real.
Options market prices a ~14.5% move; heavily-watched telehealth/GLP-1 subscriber story gives real KPI trails to research but sentiment/narrative swings dominate.
Mid-cap freelance marketplace with a live AI-disruption narrative and volatile prints; GSV/take-rate trend data is public and analyzable.
Small-cap adtech DSP with clear ad-spend/take-rate KPIs and useful peer read-throughs (Trade Desk et al.) already reported.
Large, heavily-scrutinized DTC/wholesale growth story with rich alt-data (traffic, sell-through, FX) and history of beating implied moves.
Small-cap subscriber-growth consumer app with a history of large earnings-day swings; app-store rankings and ARPU trends offer genuine alt-data edge.
CARVYKTI commercial launch trajectory versus BMS's Abecma is a real, trackable KPI story rather than a pure binary readout, and reports move the stock meaningfully.
Post-spinoff uniform-rental turnaround with a history of guidance cuts and sharp reactions; churn/margin trend is trackable across quarters.
Small specialty-pharma with volatile prints; ophthalmic launch trajectories (VEVYE/IHEEZO) are trackable KPIs giving real edge versus thin sell-side coverage.
